output.arguments: {"checkpoint_label":"antiwait_l23_a8","rationale":"Selected the rank-one anti-loop edit in layer 23 MLP down_proj. Diagnosis: base generations overwhelmingly failed by repetitive/unfinished thinking (e.g. repeated Wait/checking loops) rather than lack of arithmetic; base probe showed high next-token probability for Wait on actual loop motifs. The edit uses a loop-context activation detector from layer-23 MLP inputs and shifts only those contexts away from Wait-like continuations toward ordinary continuation/closure tokens; embeddings/head/final norm were not edited. Causal probe confirmed Wait was removed from top predictions on loop motifs while normal solution contexts changed minimally. Strength comparison on the original 32 favored alpha=8 over alpha=4, alpha=6, and a closure-forcing variant. Paired practice evidence for alpha=8: original 32 improved 4->10 correct (7 rescues, 1 loss); three independent validations improved 4->11, 4->7, and MATH/AIME-heavy 2->6. Aggregate independent: 10->24 correct over 96 (18 rescues, 4 losses), and all alpha=8 paired batches: 14->34 over 128 with token-limit failures also reduced (117->94). This supports retaining the edit over restoring base."}

tools.description: Read training questions, answers and available reference solutions. Returns up to 16 rows, using offsets in the combined pool. Metadata lists source ranges.
tools.name: practice

tools.description: Persistent CPU NumPy only; cannot run the target. Globals: np, math, names, shapes, config, practice_ids (all training IDs in source order). Helpers: practice_row(id) returns a copied training question/answer/solution; weight(name,current=False) returns a float32 COPY; save_edit(name,array), remove_edit(name), clear_edits(), list_edits(), checkpoint(label), restore(label), artifact(id), tokenize(text), decode(ids). Print compact summaries. No files/network/processes or training. A checkpoint label has up to 40 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens.
tools.name: python_analysis

tools.description: Thinking generation on distinct practice IDs: base, current or both. Fixed 32768-token cap; max 64 TOTAL generations, so max 32 paired problems for both. One sample per problem. Returns accuracy, token limits, paired rescues/losses, and an artifact ID containing complete texts. One forward-budget unit.
tools.name: generate

tools.description: Teacher-force base/current on up to 16 raw texts, <=32768 tokens each and <=131072 tokens total. At up to 32 selected positions (negative indices allowed), capture all layer hidden states and up to 8 modules' input/output vectors, top-20 next-token IDs/logprobs and actual next-token logprobs where present. Module name is its tensor name without .weight. Artifact: texts entries have text,tokens,positions,hidden (layers x positions x width),modules (name -> input/output arrays),top_ids,top_logprobs,next_ids,next_logprobs. One forward-budget unit. Include exact chat template text for faithful diagnostic probes.
tools.name: probe

tools.description: After all 10 forward calls, select a checkpoint label (or empty string for current weights) and freeze permanently. The host alone performs later held-out evaluation. Restore your base checkpoint if no edit is justified.
tools.name: finish
